entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return these absolutely worthless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable!

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

Don't you give me that corporate script! They're garbage! I spent an hour setting up the cleats, went for one ride, and they gave me the worst blisters I've ever had. I want a full refund, and I want it now!

I can definitely understand your frustration. Getting blisters on a ride is a terrible experience, and I do apologize for that. In order to process a return, I just need to pull up your order details. Do you have your order number handy?

Look, if you don't process this refund immediately, I'm going to speak to your manager and I will light up every review site on the internet about your junk products. Is that clear? The order number is VF88602.
Thank you, I'm pulling that up now... VF88602. Okay, I see your order for the Velo-Pro cycling shoes, delivered eleven days ago. Let me just check our policy.
There's nothing to check! Just give me my money back!

You're absolutely right. I've confirmed that your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now.
Oh. So... I just ship them back and I get the full refund?

That's correct. Just pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the full amount will be credited back to your original form of payment. The email with the label has just been sent.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
